- Pilot: 3 ambulatory clinics, focus on reducing clinician note time by ~30%.
- Must preserve PHI separation; audit trail required.
- Target decision window: early Q1.

Asks (if you can share by EOD Tue):
1) Economic owner: who signs pilot spend (name + email + earliest approval date).
2) Security contact: who will own the SOC 2 questionnaire and whether an initial 30-min security briefing is possible before formal questionnaire.
3) Procurement workflow: does Aurelia prefer a standalone SOW for pilots or a PO against an MSA? Any required procurement contacts (name + email).

We attached a one-pager with two pilot pricing tiers to make internal review easier (redwood-pilot-options-onepager.pdf). If you share the names above well tailor the one-pager to the buyer and include a quick appendix on data controls.

Proposed next meeting: 30-min alignment call with procurement + security week of Nov 30. Prefer Dec 1 @ 14:00 PT or Dec 2 @ 11:00 PT 1 can you confirm availability?

Thanks,
